name: SUN397
description: Scene classification dataset with 397 categories and about 108,000 images, using a 50/50 train/test split protocol. Dataset files are not vendored here.
citation: Xiao, J., Hays, J., Ehinger, K. A., Oliva, A., & Torralba, A. (2010). SUN397: A new benchmark and database of scene categories. Proceedings of the IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR).
